title: Disruptive innovation
caption: Incumbents improve faster than mainstream customers need. A simpler, cheaper product starts below even the mainstream's needs, then improves until it is good enough, and customers switch.
alt: Performance against time: incumbents' sustaining products rise above the mainstream customers' needs; a disruptive product starts far below but climbs faster and crosses the mainstream need at year 6.
description: Incumbents' products rise faster and soon exceed what mainstream customers need.
The disruptive product starts worse on traditional measures but improves faster.
At year 6 it becomes good enough for mainstream customers, who then switch.
